verdict.rationale: Paddle documents a unified Billing API with an OpenAPI 3.1 spec and a Postman collection covering every operation. Docs repeatedly describe dashboard actions as also available via the API: creating transactions, metrics, reports, subscription changes and invoices. The hosted MCP server's codemode tools are described as covering the full API, explicitly in place of navigating the dashboard. missing for 10: no explicit first-party UI/API parity guarantee, apparent dashboard-only steps (API key creation in Developer tools, Payment Recovery/Retain configuration), no independent or hands-on corroboration of coverage.
